# Architecture Best Practices for Microsoft Workloads

Sign in

## AWS re:Invent 2025

### CEO Matt Garman shares how AWS is shaping the future of cloud tech

Join AWS CEO Matt Garman to hear how AWS is innovating across every aspect of the world’s leading cloud. He explores how we are reinventing foundational building blocks as well as developing brand new experiences, all to empower customers and partners with what they need to build a better future.

Learn more

### AI agents in action: Architecting the future of applications

Explore how agentic AI is transforming cloud-native application architecture, unlocking faster innovation cycles and entirely new application patterns. Learn how new AWS capabilities empower builders to design secure, reasoning-driven agents that orchestrate data, code, and tools at scale, with an emphasis on governance, reliability, and cost efficiency. Discover how AWS customers are deploying production-ready agents today, and learn best practices to help you architect agentic applications that autonomously adapt, optimize, and act in real-time.

Learn more

### AWS migration journey: 2025 itinerary for Microsoft workloads

Ready to take your Microsoft migration journey to the next level in a world of AI-based tools? Join us for a session that showcases migration tools, mechanisms, and best practices supporting your Microsoft ecosystem. Whether you're migrating Active Directory, File Servers, Application Servers, or SQL databases, discover how to transform your landscape with precision and confidence on AWS. Learn firsthand how these services and solutions streamline complex migrations, reduce manual effort, and accelerate your migration journey.

Learn more

### Building agentic AI applications on Amazon Bedrock using C# and .NET

Discover the full potential of agentic AI in your .NET applications using automated multistep reasoning provided by Amazon Bedrock Agents. Learn how to securely create sophisticated AI agents in .NET that provide access to company systems, APIs, and data sources in real-time. We'll demonstrate practical patterns for building intelligent agents that leverage your existing .NET investments while harnessing Amazon's powerful AI capabilities. By the end of this session, you'll gain the necessary knowledge and confidence to build .NET Agentic AI applications that make intelligent decisions with your data, delivering immediate value to your organization.

Learn more
